verdict.rationale: RustDesk documents its own capability to avoid vendor infrastructure. You can run your own rendezvous/relay server ([rustdesk-gh-1], [rustdesk-docs-1]), and clients connect peer-to-peer with end-to-end encryption, falling back to your relay ([rustdesk-docs-8], [rustdesk-docs-11]). A long-time user confirms it works with no account and their own lookup/relay server ([rustdesk-comm-6]). However, the evidence never shows local-network host discovery or serverless direct connection. One user reports it seemed to require a relay server and could not connect directly by IP ([rustdesk-comm-4]), so some rendezvous server still appears to sit in the path. missing for 10: documented LAN auto-discovery of hosts, documented direct-IP/serverless connection on the local network, first-party docs stating no account is required.
